decision_policy.primary: Target eligibility verified in full article or an explicitly identified primary regulatory full report. Unknown concentration remains explicit and prevents concentration-specific pooling.

decision_policy.excluded: A verified feature is outside the primary question.
decision_policy.unresolved: Original access or an essential eligibility/formulation/source-linkage condition remains unverified; strong abstract/registry signals are retained without promotion.

records.title: Modeling Pharmacokinetic Profiles of Insulin Regimens to Enhance Understanding of Subcutaneous Insulin Regimens.
records.reason: The lispro population model was trained on healthy volunteers, not the target adult T1D population; secondary T1D profile overlays are useful ancestry evidence but do not make the training cohort T1D.

facts.population: Table 1 lispro training cohort: eight healthy participants, 21–28 years. Sixteen clinical studies across multiple insulin products overall.

remaining_uncertainties: Supplemental equations noted but not separately retrieved in this check.

records.reason: This is useful mechanistic exercise modeling, but it intentionally pools lispro and aspart with identical assumed kinetics and does not report a separately reconstructible lispro cohort.

facts.population: Mayo resting cohort: 19 enrolled, 13 using aspart and six lispro; two missing-data exclusions leave 17. Exercise cohort: 14, two rapid-absorption outliers excluded, leaving 12.

facts.concentration: Lispro/aspart concentration and exercise-group analogue allocation not located.

remaining_uncertainties: Adult eligibility range not established from the reported mean ages alone.
